record.description: Third v0.7.0 phase. Lands the native Track/Milestone/Batch/Task/Run/Release path behind the daemon transaction contract, the provider contract and its conformance runner (REL-035), the semantic-tool gateway, WorkLease, candidate sealing, serialized integration, and the console chassis fixture-verified with its projection seam, launcher in P34. dev2 reached BAKED on three live registries; the dev3 cut defers to P34 for want of an accepted Milestone bundle. record.title: Cut the 0.7.0.dev3 native canary checkpoint
record.description: Fourth v0.7.0 phase, cuts 0.7.0.dev3 (D61). Repins squashed wave pins, backfills P32/P33 receipts, makes inert gates fail, lands fast-forward landing (D66), fixes B156-B158, lands the native producers (create transition, PendingAction, skill principal, delivery assembler, candidate submission, Run meter), opens the console from eawf tui on epoch-2 trees (D63), closes 39 fixed backlog rows, drives dev3 to APPROVED; BAKED opens P35.

record.title: Ship the dev4 planning and steering surfaces and rehearse the cutover
record.description: Planning transaction, identity and research campaign repairs (I01), the compiled rule graph and steering projections (I02), the skill catalog, measurement, notices and quality homes (I03), and the epoch-2 cutover readiness with a pinned-clone rehearsal and bound console verbs (I04). The live cutover and its native follow-ups moved to P36 by D69.

Sixth v0.7.0 phase, retitled by D71: epoch-2-aware commit lint, trace and legacy-continuation routes (D69, D73), release-path and audit-leftover backlog before the cut, the live epoch-2 cutover of this repository (D62), the console live on this tree (D63), the rc1, rc2 and stable roadmap authored as native plans with typed satisfied dispositions (D65, D72), and 0.7.0.dev5 as the product_canary rung (D70). rc1 moves to the next phase.

payload.title: Cut 0.7.0rc3: remove the epoch-1 engine, fix reflect, close operator gaps
payload.description: Child of PRV-0305 (APPLIED) that re-plans the still-PLANNED MLS-0104. Operator decision of 2026-10-22 (Claude Code session, recorded in .ea/local/research/2026-10-22-rc3-widening-2.md 'Operator decisions'): fix reflect and pull its totals, issues list and selection flags into rc3; take every remaining legacy item into rc3 (wiring gaps of EAWF-0468..0476, unclaimed epoch-1 residue, profile cadence migration, non-epoch-1 test-only dead code); make AS-02 passable, port the hook v1 reads, fix the state cursor lag, add Claude 5 pricing rows and make eawf validate epoch-2. Promotes drafts EAWF-0461, 0462 and 0485..0491 and adds Batches BAT-0326..0328. The first widening (EAWF-0477..0484) is approved by operator evidence eawf://EAWF/evidence/EVD-0040. Original scope: EAWF-0464..0476 (.ea/local/2026-10-11-backlog-review/mls-rc3.json).
payload.outcome: A fresh tree is born native and no live surface, daemon loop, rule, agent page or test reads or teaches the epoch-1 phase, iter and wave model; only the migration and upgrade path still reads v1 state, and every epoch-1 word left in src/ sits in a reasoned census allowlist. The eawf Claude Code hooks load and their report hooks run on a native tree, a Milestone made with milestone create takes its first plan, and an operator or agent can edit, cancel and rename Milestones and Tracks, list and show every entity as JSON, give a Task a title and a description, join a workspace after init, keep heavy scratch out of .ea/local, read a reflect report of every finished Run with money and token totals, and validate an epoch-2 tree, all without editing state by hand.
exclusions: the 0.6.8 upgrade and migration readers, flag-day retirement messages and the sealed legacy snapshot, which stay as compatibility
the multi-project aggregate console route EAWF-0452, which ships in 0.7.1
the Allods issues 3, 9, 10, 11 and 13 to 17 of the 2026-10-22 state review section 2, and the Allods .ea disk use, which the operator left as is
a full STE rewrite of rule, skill and prompt prose; only an advisory lint ships
reflect --cohort, estimate-versus-actual variance, the all_local and workspace reflect scopes and the first-pass verification manifest, which ship in 0.7.1

payload.title: Cut 0.7.0rc3: remove the epoch-1 engine, fix reflect, close operator gaps
payload.description: Child of PRV-0305 (APPLIED) that re-plans the still-PLANNED MLS-0104. Operator decision of 2026-10-22 (Claude Code session, recorded in .ea/local/research/2026-10-22-rc3-widening-2.md 'Operator decisions'): fix reflect and pull its totals, issues list and selection flags into rc3; take every remaining legacy item into rc3 (wiring gaps of EAWF-0468..0476, unclaimed epoch-1 residue, profile cadence migration, non-epoch-1 test-only dead code); make AS-02 passable, port the hook v1 reads, fix the state cursor lag, add Claude 5 pricing rows and make eawf validate epoch-2. Promotes drafts EAWF-0461, 0462 and 0485..0491 and adds Batches BAT-0326..0328. The first widening (EAWF-0477..0484) is approved by operator evidence eawf://EAWF/evidence/EVD-0040. Original scope: EAWF-0464..0476 (.ea/local/2026-10-11-backlog-review/mls-rc3.json).
payload.outcome: A fresh tree is born native and no live surface, daemon loop, rule, agent page or test reads or teaches the epoch-1 phase, iter and wave model; only the migration and upgrade path still reads v1 state, and every epoch-1 word left in src/ sits in a reasoned census allowlist. The eawf Claude Code hooks load and their report hooks run on a native tree, a Milestone made with milestone create takes its first plan, and an operator or agent can edit, cancel and rename Milestones and Tracks, list and show every entity as JSON, give a Task a title and a description, join a workspace after init, keep heavy scratch out of .ea/local, read a reflect report of every finished Run with money and token totals, and validate an epoch-2 tree, all without editing state by hand.
exclusions: the 0.6.8 upgrade and migration readers, flag-day retirement messages and the sealed legacy snapshot, which stay as compatibility
the multi-project aggregate console route EAWF-0452, which ships in 0.7.1
the Allods issues 3, 9, 10, 11 and 13 to 17 of the 2026-10-22 state review section 2, and the Allods .ea disk use, which the operator left as is
a full STE rewrite of rule, skill and prompt prose; only an advisory lint ships
reflect --cohort, estimate-versus-actual variance, the all_local and workspace reflect scopes and the first-pass verification manifest, which ship in 0.7.1
